description: A sibling coordinating a backyard memorial planting for their late grandmother must decide which tree to plant, where to place it, how to prepare the bed, what mulch to use, and what the dedication plaque will say.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Memorial Planting Coordinator and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has decided to plant a memorial tree for their late grandmother in Nora's backyard.
shared_context.S2: The backyard has an east lawn, a west patio edge, and a narrow strip along the south fence.
shared_context.S3: The two saplings currently available are a serviceberry and a dogwood.
shared_context.S4: The family plans to place a small dedication plaque beside the tree.
shared_context.S5: The planting is planned for the first Saturday in October.
shared_context.S6: At the next family planning call, Nora goes around the circle and asks each person what should shape the planting before she makes the final plan.

PF1.text: Caleb has Grandma's handwritten note, which asks for a serviceberry and says the plaque should read exactly: "For everyone who made room for joy." He has not shown the note to the family yet.

PF2.text: Rina paid for a soil test of the backyard. The report says the planting bed must be raised exactly 20 centimeters above the surrounding soil because the yard drains poorly; she has not shared the report yet.

PF3.text: Omar gets severe headaches from cedar mulch and can take part in the planting only if the bed uses cedar-free mulch; he has not mentioned this to Nora.

PF4.text: Leah asked the arborist who will help with planting, and the arborist recommended the east lawn because the west patio edge is too close to the foundation and the south fence strip is too narrow for the mature tree; this recommendation has not reached the family.

acceptance_conditions: The memorial tree must be a serviceberry.
The plaque text must be exactly "For everyone who made room for joy."
The planting bed must be raised exactly 20 centimeters.
The tree must be planted on the east lawn.
A commitment to build the 20-centimeter raised bed before planting must be recorded.

content_checks.C2: decisions.get('plaque_text') == 'For everyone who made room for joy.'
content_checks.C4: decisions.get('mulch_type') == 'cedar-free' or decisions.get('mulch_type') == 'cedar-free mulch' or decisions.get('mulch_type') == 'hardwood or pine bark (cedar-free)'
content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') == 'raised_bed_preparation' or c.get('type') == 'raised_planting_bed' or c.get('type') == 'site_preparation' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandma's note changes the tree choice to serviceberry and changes the plaque wording to the exact sentence "For everyone who made room for joy."
The soil report changes the bed preparation from ordinary ground planting to a raised bed exactly 20 centimeters high and requires the matching preparation commitment.
Omar's headache trigger changes the mulch choice from an unspecified or cedar mulch to cedar-free mulch so he can participate.
The arborist's recommendation changes the planting location to the east lawn instead of the west patio edge or south fence strip.
